No masterclass

From a PDF straight to a booking

A woman who downloads your free guide has one next step: pay for time with you. Most aren’t ready for that yet, so they read, follow and wait.

Every offer is your time

Revenue is capped by your diary

Your paid offers are calls, sessions and support with you. There’s no product that sells while you’re speaking, resting or with your family.

No ads

Reach depends on the algorithm

One reel hit 1.5m views. Your last seven ranged from 503 to 21.4k. Without ads, there’s no way to turn that message into a steady flow of booked calls.

The women who aren’t ready for 1:1 today leave with a PDF, and you have no way of knowing which of them would say yes to RISE.

A free live masterclass between your reels and RISE

You already have the smaller offers. A free class gives women a reason to show up, sells a £37 starter kit and your Clarity call to the ones not ready for mentoring, and shows you who is ready for RISE.

Is this you?

The surgery is over. The rebuilding is where many women feel alone.

  • You’ve been the strong one for so long, you’re not sure where to start with yourself.
  • You want to feel like you again, and move with confidence again.
  • You leave appointments with more questions than answers.
  • You’ve spent years looking after everyone else first.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

The side of recovery nobody plans for

The practical, emotional and identity changes many women face in the months after surgery, and how to plan for them.

How to walk into appointments prepared

The questions worth asking your medical team, so you leave with clarity instead of confusion.

Rebuilding your sense of self

How to reconnect with who you are when life has changed, and why it’s never too late to invest in yourself.

Moving again, gently and at your own pace

The principles behind building movement back into your week, always alongside your medical team’s guidance.

Asking for support without guilt

Strong women need support too. How to ask for it at home and at work, and protect your peace.

Meet Sahir

Hi, I’m Sahir

I’m a speaker, women’s health educator and advocate, and a 50-year-old grandmother. For more than 15 years I battled deep infiltrating endometriosis and adenomyosis, with multiple surgeries and surgical menopause along the way.

I turned my pain into purpose. Today I help women rebuild their health and identity, and I challenge what keeps women suffering, from my Instagram community of 35.4k to the House of Lords.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this medical advice?

No. This is an education and coaching class. It doesn’t diagnose or treat any condition, and it doesn’t replace advice from your doctor or medical team.

Who is this class for?

Women navigating life around endometriosis surgery, hysterectomy or surgical menopause, whether that’s months ago or years ago.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay.

Is it really free?

Yes. Come, learn, ask your questions, and decide afterwards if you’d like more support.
